title: J1939 Transmit
text: Transmit J1939 message, 2 inputs; {Config name} sets the name of the J1939 network configuration to associate, {Node name} sets the name of the J1939, {Parameter Group} sets the group number, {Signals}, {PG Priority} sets the priority of the parameter, {Destination Address} sets the name of the destination and {Sample time} sets the simulation transmit rate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Config name
params.values: Name of the J1939 network configuration to associate ConfigX (default) | character vector

params.name: Node name
params.values: Name of the J1939 node NodeX (default) | character vector

params.name: Signals
params.values: Signals defined in parameter group array of character vectors

params.name: PG Priority
params.values: Priority of the parameter group int8

params.name: Destination Address
params.values: Name of the destination node int8
